outcome: Oncologic outcomes (recurrence rate, disease-free survival, survival without evidence of disease)
Obstetric outcomes (attempts to conceive, pregnancies, live births, preterm births, term births, miscarriages, fetal loss)
cohort: Patients aged 18-45 years with 2018 FIGO stage IB1 cervical cancer desiring fertility who underwent conization and pelvic lymphadenectomy in two Italian centers between January 1993 and December 2019.
finding: Conization is a feasible conservative management for women with stage IB1 cervical cancer desiring fertility, showing favorable oncologic outcomes (91.6% 3-year disease-free survival) and a reported 12 live births out of 18 pregnancies among those who tried to conceive.
